origin.description: A GitLab personal access token. Looks in env var GITLAB_PAT.

arguments.name: quiet
arguments.text: When FALSE, message that the token came from the env var GITLAB_PAT. Default TRUE.

origin.details: Reads Sys.getenv("GITLAB_PAT"). A string with non-zero nchar is returned. When quiet is FALSE, message("Using GitLab PAT from envvar GITLAB_PAT") is also sent. An unset or empty variable returns NULL. An empty string is not a token.
origin.value: The token, or NULL when GITLAB_PAT is unset or empty.
origin.example:
Sys.setenv(GITLAB_PAT = "glpat-example")
cat(paste0("with GITLAB_PAT=glpat-example, gitlab_pat() returns ", gitlab_pat(), ".\n"))

translation.description: A GitLab personal access token. Looks in env var GITLAB_PAT.

arguments.name: quiet
arguments.text: When False, write that the token came from the env var GITLAB_PAT. Default True.

translation.details: Reads the environment variable GITLAB_PAT. A non-empty string is returned. When quiet is False, the message Using GitLab PAT from envvar GITLAB_PAT is written to stderr. An unset or empty variable returns None. An empty string is not a token.
translation.value: The token, or None when GITLAB_PAT is unset or empty.
translation.example:
import os
from remotes.gitlab_pat import gitlab_pat
os.environ["GITLAB_PAT"] = "glpat-example"
print("with GITLAB_PAT=glpat-example, gitlab_pat() returns " + gitlab_pat() + ".")
